scripts.dev: npm run build -w @briefharbor/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @briefharbor/api" "npm run dev -w @briefharbor/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @briefharbor/contracts && npm run build -w @briefharbor/api && npm run build -w @briefharbor/web
scripts.test:demo: npm run build -w @briefharbor/contracts && node --import tsx --test apps/web/test/demo-workflow.mjs
